about: Every project LayerTime-Sensors takes signatures from, checks them against, or credits. Rows in src/lts/Signatures.h name a source by its id. upstream_seen_sha is the newest upstream commit seen by the last review; last_reviewed_sha is the commit that review read through; integrated_sha is the commit the library's rows were last taken from. test_sources fails if a row names an id that is not here.

license_rule.data_only: Anything else: AGPL, no license, a custom or unclear license, or GPL-2.0-only. Factual data (identifiers, names, thresholds) may be used with credit; code is never copied.

sources.name: SquachWatch-CYD
sources.author: skizzophrenic
sources.notes: Keeps per-signature provenance in docs/DETECTIONS.md. Its own credits name @NitekryDPaul, DeFlockJoplin, flock-you, and nyanBOX.

sources.name: flock-you
sources.author: colonelpanichacks
sources.notes: The 8 Silicon Labs Flock rows came from its 2025 FS Ext Battery dataset at 3515c5f67e3a915cffa503c1a1d019ff130a13b8. The QCA9377 row and the XUNTONG attribution are from 6704f01.

sources.name: nite-oui-collection
sources.author: nitekry (@NitekryDPaul)
sources.notes: Field-tested Flock prefixes in groups/flockers/my_tested_flock.md. Credits the original list to GainSec.

sources.name: Wall of Flippers
sources.author: k3yomi
sources.notes: Documents the Flipper Zero service UUIDs 0x3081 to 0x3083 (utils/wof_cache.py).

sources.name: wall-of-flipper
sources.author: 7h30th3r0n3
sources.notes: Confirms the Flipper UUIDs. Its models.py also treats 0C:FA:22, 80:E1:26 and 80:E1:27 as genuine Flipper prefixes; SquachWatch-CYD 3d66846 found 0C:FA:22 on Flipper's BUSY Bar instead. Not used yet.

sources.name: Evil-M5Project
sources.author: 7h30th3r0n3
sources.notes: Matches the same Flipper service UUIDs. Its imsiCatcher() collects identities and is excluded on purpose.

sources.name: nyanBOX
sources.author: jbohack
sources.notes: SquachWatch-CYD ported its AirTag payload check from nyanBOX; the Find My subtype rule reached this library through that port.

sources.name: Kismet
sources.author: Mike Kershaw (dragorn) and contributors
sources.notes: conf/kismet_device_rules_highlights.txt tags body cameras by 00:25:df, 12:20:13, or a name starting Axon-X (f62be8498b4b668c8975c319b17dd73d04f92963). Review began with the commits of 2026-10-29 and 2026-10-30. Also a reference for evil-twin and rogue-AP alerts (catalog Tier 3).

sources.name: GainSec Flock research
sources.author: Jon "GainSec" Gaines
sources.notes: nite-oui-collection credits GainSec with the original Flock prefix list. The list itself was not found in a GainSec repository, so no commit is recorded.

sources.name: Wireshark generated registry tables
sources.author: The Wireshark project
sources.notes: epan/manuf-data.c and epan/dissectors/data-bluetooth.c, rebuilt weekly from the IEEE and Bluetooth SIG files. tools/refresh_registry_snapshots.py reads them into sources/snapshots/.

sources.name: IEEE Registration Authority, MA-L/MA-M/MA-S
sources.author: IEEE
sources.notes: The authority behind sources/snapshots/ieee_oui.tsv, read through the Wireshark mirror.

sources.name: Bluetooth SIG Assigned Numbers
sources.author: Bluetooth SIG
sources.notes: The authority behind sources/snapshots/bt_sig_*.tsv, read through the Wireshark mirror.

sources.name: Earlier LayerTime watch firmware
sources.author: Michael Van Geertruy
sources.notes: Rows carried over from the firmware this library was extracted from, where the upstream origin was not recorded. Each one is a candidate for finding and crediting its real source.
